blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed 2026-10-19. USDKG supply is 94% on Tron and 6% on Ethereum (census). At Tron block 87239289, the Tron contract TXZo12qvnEVKvU2zbfuQeMXKusWyxonwEG returns owner()=TEmt2RaL2w6x51Lkx75hsDpBv63aPYA8jd (the verified 3-of-7 multisig), paused()=false and totalSupply()=47,000,000 USDKG. Its TronGrid ABI exposes addBlackList(address), removeBlackList(address), destroyBlackFunds(address) and getBlackListStatus(address), all owner-gated alongside pause/unpause; the owner is non-zero, so the blacklist and blacklisted-balance destruction controls are active. The ConsenSys Diligence USDKG audit independently identifies the compliance blacklist and destroyBlackFunds path. Ethereum holds 6% and is disclosed but sub-threshold; its ownership was observed at block 26095805.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDKG has no cross-chain bridge: it is a standalone Tether-style token issued and burned natively on each chain by the issuer (Gold Dollar / OJSC Virtual Asset Issuer) via issue()/redeem() functions, with separate, non-identical contract addresses on Ethereum (0xe820...45e3) and Tron (TXZo12...nwEG). Supply on each chain is independently issuer-minted against gold reserves with no cross-chain dependency, so the route is single-chain-or-native rather than opaque.
